name: Policy
description: Publisher-side (Antipodean) — open question OQ-17 (what the broker sees after bind) is not yet settled; see contract artefact 2 §6. A bound policy: identifiers, dates, void/renewal calendar, the four per-entity timer topics (contract artefact 5), and the MTA/sanctions state fields P9 needs for absence-shaped queries (contract artefact 1 system_keys).
label: Policy

policy_number.title: Policy number
policy_number.description: Records enforce no uniqueness — the bind flow's idempotency condition node is the guard, not the index (contract artefact 2).

quote_id.title: Quote id
quote_id.description: A duplicate bind must return the first outcome, not mint a second policy (plan §7.4 item 6).

policy_status.title: Policy status
policy_status.description: The scan's query is 'ACTIVE and past a deadline' — a positive filter, never 'not VOIDED' (contract artefact 2 limits.L1). Vocabulary: contract artefact 4 cross-reference table.

bind_date.title: Bind date
bind_date.description: Day 0 of the 46/61 calendar, anchored to timezone_anchor. §6.1's index_fields minimum names this field explicitly — it is the input to every deadline computation (plan §4.4).

expiration_date.title: Expiration date
expiration_date.description: The T-100/T-90 renewal backstop window. Same field as spec's 'expiry_date' — one spelling; spec's enumerated name wins (01-key-list.json system_keys S-01).

void_after_days.title: Void after days
void_after_days.description: Plan §6.1 explicit requirement. Chosen over spec §5.2's void_grace_days — the plan is the later document (01-key-list.json system_keys S-03, flagged as A-12).

void_due_date.title: Void due date
void_due_date.description: bind_date + void_after_days, anchored. Re-stamped by flow 5 on reinstatement, so the reconcile scan reads the current value, not a computed one.

void_override_reason.title: Void override reason
void_override_reason.description: Spec §4.5.5 term-extension override. Required justification — the only place §4.5's 'mandatory' can live, because no audit trail on a record edit exists anywhere (plan §6.4). Enforced by the task template's required form field, not by this schema.

voidance_notice_state.title: Voidance notice state
voidance_notice_state.description: ADDED BY ARTEFACT 1. Positive form of the absence of voidance_notice_sent_at, which is not queryable.

voidance_notice_sent_at.title: Voidance notice sent at
voidance_notice_sent_at.description: NULLABLE — RFC3339 or empty string, never a placeholder (contract artefact 2 limits.L8). Read by name; voidance_notice_state carries the query (plan R9).

timers_scheduled.title: Timers scheduled
timers_scheduled.description: ADDED BY ARTEFACT 1. Flow 13's exception query — 'never scheduled or silently lost' is an absence query and therefore unaskable; this is the positive form. Stamped in the same write as the four topic fields below.

mta_state.title: MTA state
mta_state.description: ADDED BY ARTEFACT 1. 'none' must be written explicitly, never an empty string — an empty header value is dropped before indexing.

active_mta_id.title: Active MTA id
active_mta_id.description: For the direct lookup once mta_state says there is one. Plan §6.1 explicit requirement.

timezone_anchor.title: Timezone anchor (IANA)
timezone_anchor.description: Business input (plan §7.5 item 10, open question 11, contract artefact 5 A5-2). Anchors day-46/day-61/T-100/T-90. A UTC-anchored day-61 voids a Perth policy ~16h early against a stated local 23:59. Stamped at bind; changing it later re-dates every deadline.

invoice_overdue_timer_topic.title: invoice-overdue timer topic
invoice_overdue_timer_topic.description: The stored, derived topic for the 'invoice-overdue:<policyId>' schedule — the ONLY thing microstrate.hub.delete.unschedule-flow accepts (contract artefact 5). Three states: absent/null = never scheduled or the stamp write failed (the exception condition — see timers_scheduled); empty string = deliberately not scheduled because trigger_on was already past; non-empty = the live topic.

policy_void_timer_topic.description: The stored, derived topic for the 'policy-void:<policyId>' schedule — the ONLY thing microstrate.hub.delete.unschedule-flow accepts (contract artefact 5).
